text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.orig_text:
せい、
はっ！
えーい、
さーっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}! Haitai!
This? It's image training!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
{0}！
　
ハイターイ♪
これー？
　イメージトレーニングさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Majimun are related to my homeland,
so I'm feeling all fired up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
相手はマジムンだからねー
故郷の血が騒ぐんだよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
How about you give it a shot, too?
Don't worry. Just follow my lead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}もやってみるー？
大丈夫、
私の真似をしたらいいだけよー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: First, you focus and create an image in your mind...
text_block_list.orig_text: まずは集中してイメージするさー……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You can see a bunch of Majimun when you do that, right?
All you gotta do after that is take them down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
目の前にマジムンがいっぱい出てくるでしょー？
それをなぎ倒すんさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You can't see them?
You're not focusing enough. Create a stronger image!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
出てこない～？
集中力が足りないさ～、
もっと強くイメージするさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's too hard? Hm... Not much you can do about that, then!
Just sit by and cheer me on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
難しい？　
う～ん、
仕方ないさ～！
じゃあ、そこで応援しててほしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Imagining that you're cheering me on just isn't enough, after all. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の応援だけは、
イメージじゃ満足できないからね～♪
